Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out on the middle now. Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma are the two openers for India Women. Darcie Brown to start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, Australia Women have posted a massive total on the board and with their bowling attack they will be confident enough of defending it. India Women, on the other hand need to attack form the very first ball as they don't have any other option. Let's see how the chase unfolds. Stay tuned for the second essay.

India Women will be disappointed with their bowling effort. They started well getting rid of both the openers quite early. Then the spinners came into play and provided a couple of more breakthroughs. However, it all went downhill from there. They just did not have any answer to the power-hitting of Grace Harris and Ashleigh Gardner. They were also a bit sloppy in the field giving away a few overthrows and allowing the batters to put more pressure on them. Deepti Sharma, Devika Vaidya, Anjali Sarvani and Shafali Verma all got one wicket each, but except for Devika Vaidya, all were expensive. Now, they have a mammoth total to chase to save some pride and finish the series 3-2.

Australia Women have put on another solid batting display here. They found themselves in some early trouble losing both their openers for cheap scores. It was then Ellyse Perry and Tahlia McGrath who steadied the ship for them before getting dismissed in quick succession. However, they set the perfect platform for the power hitters to come in and they did not disappoint. Grace Harris and Ashleigh Gardner were on fire and smashed it all around the park. They added 129 runs off just 62 balls and both batters scored half-centuries and remained unbeaten.

A breathtaking batting performance from Australia Women! They end on a huge total of 196 which is the highest score in this series. India Women played an extra bowler in place of a batter, but that plan did not work at all and they will have to overcome all the odds to gun this down.
Full on off, Grace Harris fails to get under it and drives this one down to long off for a single. Australia Women end up with 196 on the board!
Follows the batter and bowls a good yorker, Ashleigh Gardner can only drive this one towards extra cover for a single.
FOUR! TWO IN A ROW! Full and on off, right in the slot for the batter, Ashleigh Gardner clears her front and drills it hard past the mid on fielder for another boundary.
FOUR! Low full toss outside off, Ashleigh Gardner gets down the track and hammers this one to the right of the deep mid-wicket fielder for a boundary.
Full outside off, Grace Harris shuffles across to scoop but miscues it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Low full toss on middle, Ashleigh Gardner slogs this one towards square leg and collects a single.
Renuka Singh (3-1-21-0) to bowl the last over.
Yorker around off, Grace Harris can only jam this one out to the bowler.
FOUR! Full on middle, Grace Harris uses her feet and drills it back past Deepti Sharma. Hits it right between long on and long off for a boundary.

Four Overthrows! Fullish on middle by Deepti Sharma, Grace Harris drives this one back to the bowler, Deepti Sharma collects and fires a wayward throw to the keeper. Richa Ghosh fails to collect this one and it races past her for a boundary.
Yorker on middle, Grace Harris jams this one out back to the bowler.
Full toss on middle, Ashleigh Gardner does not time this one well and pushes it down to long on for a single.
FOUR! Full on middle, Ashleigh Gardner shuffles across to create room and swipes this one along the ground and past Smriti Mandhana at deep square leg for a boundary.
Fullish on middle, Ashleigh Gardner works this one down to long on for a single.
FOUR! FIFTY for Ashleigh Gardner! Full on middle, Ashleigh Gardner uses her feet and goes through with the shot. Drills it hard and wide of long on for a boundary.
Full on off, Grace Harris knocks it down to long on for a single.
SIX! FIFTY for Grace Harris! Renuka Singh misses her length and bowls a slower full toss on off, Grace Harris waits for it and swings this one towards the square fence on the leg side for a maximum.

FOUR BYES! Slower on a length outside off by Renuka Singh, Grace Harris goes through with the slog early and fails to get any bat on it. The ball goes on the bounce towards Richa Ghosh and she lets it go through her legs for a boundary.
Full on off, Ashleigh Gardner slogs across the line towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full toss on middle, hits Ashleigh Gardner high on the bat and she can only push it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Full on middle by Deepti Sharma, Ashleigh Gardner shuffles across and slogs this one towards deep square leg. Manages to get it to the right of the diving Renuka Singh for a boundary.
Full on middle, Ashleigh Gardner works this one towards short fine leg for a dot.
Fullish on middle, Grace Harris stays in the crease and drills it towards deep mid-wicket. Anjali Sarvani there runs to her right and keeps it to one.
Fullish on leg, Grace Harris fails to get under it and jams it to mid-wicket for a dot.
FOUR! Full and on middle by Deepti Sharma, Grace Harris clears her front leg and swipes across the line. Gets it just past the mid-wicket for a boundary.
Deepti Sharma (2-0-23-1) is back on.

SIX! STRAIGHT HIT! Slower and on a length around off, Ashleigh Gardner shimmies down the track and frees her arms to go through with the slog. Hits it straight back over the bowler's head for a maximum.
FOUR! Devika Vaidya misses her length and bowls a low full toss, Ashleigh Gardner takes it on the full and swats it towards the square leg fence for a maximum.
Tossed up, full and at the pads, Ashleigh Gardner uses her feet to go on the leg side but fails to get it past Renuka Singh at square leg.
Full on off, Grace Harris gets forward and works it to long off for a single.
Tossed up, fuller on middle, Grace Harris advances down the track and pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Devika Vaidya fires this one short and on off, Grace Harris picks the length early and rocks back to pull this one through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flatter full and on middle, Grace Harris works it towards long on for one.
A bit short and on off, Grace Harris pushes it towards covers.
SIX! Another one for Harris! This is quicker, full and on leg, Grace Harris goes down and slog-sweeps it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
SIX! BOOM! Nice use of the feet! This is tossed up arouund middle, Grace Harris skips down the track and smokes it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
Slower through the air, on off, Grace Harris looks to poke at it but misses.

In the air...safe! Radha Yadav starts with a short delivery, on leg, Ashleigh Gardner looks to pull it, but miscues it in the air. However it lands safely in the deep square leg region. Only a single.
Flatter, full and on off, Grace Harris knocks it back to the bowler.
Short and outside off, Ashleigh Gardner goes back and cuts it towards sweeper cover for a run.
Slower through the air, on off, Grace Harris moves back and dabs it in front of point for a quick single.
Shortish and on off, Grace Harris pushes it towards covers.
SIX! BANG! Grace Harris goes big now! This is floated, full and on middle, Grace Harris this time slog-sweeps it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
FOUR! A poor delivery and rightly punished! This is tossed up, full and on leg, Grace Harris goes down and sweeps it towards the vacant deep backward square leg for a boundary.
This is pitched up, on off, Ashleigh Gardner thrashes it wide of deep point again, but this time Rajeshwari Gayakwad cuts it out diving to her right. Two runs taken!

MISFIELD AND FOUR! This is full again and outside off, Ashleigh Gardner drives it again towards wide of deep point where Rajeshwari Gayakwad dives to her right, but lets it through for a boundary. 100 up for Australia Women!
FOUR! Make that three! Anjali Sarvani serves a half-volley, outside off, Ashleigh Gardner stays there and drives it firmly through covers for another boundary.
FOUR! Two in a row! This is a slower delivery again, short and on middle, sits up nicely for the batter, Ashleigh Gardner pulls it towards the deep square leg fence for a boundnary.
FOUR! SMASHED! Anjali Sarvani bowls a slower delivery, full and on off, Ashleigh Gardner waits for it and drills it towards the wide long off fence for a boundary.
Full and on off, Grace Harris chips it wide of long off where Radha Yadav runs to her right and cuts it out. A single is taken.
Both the batters are set now and they will want to change gears from heron.
Darts this one full and on middle, Ashleigh Gardner uses her feet and yorks herself as she digs it back to the bowler.
Short and outside of, Grace Harris punches it towards sweeper cover for one.
Flatter, full and on middle, Ashleigh Gardner eases it towards long on for a run.
Floated, full and on middle, Ashleigh Gardner chips it miscues her drive in the air just in front of mid on.
Quicker one, short and on middle, Ashleigh Gardner blocks it to the off side.
Nicely tossed up, full and on off, Grace Harris drills it to the left of the bowler where Devika Vaidya dives but lets it through to long off. They cross.
FOUR! Nice shot! This is tossed up, full and around leg, Ashleigh Gardner stays there and heaves it well to the right of long on for a boundary.
Shorter in length and outside off, Grace Harris cuts it towards deep point for a single.
Looped up, full and on off, Grace Harris mistimes her drive back towards the bowler.
Pushed through quicker, short and on off, Grace Harris looks to cut it, but misses.
Floated, short and on off, Grace Harris blocks it to the off side.
FOUR! Brilliant timing! This is tossed up, full and around off, Grace Harris drives it firmly wide of long off where Radha Yadav dives to her left, but cannot stop it from going to the boundary.
Slower and short outside off, Grace Harris cuts this one towards deep cover for a single.

FOUR! Grace Harris is up and running! Devika Vaidya fires this one short and outside off, Grace Harris looks to punch this one from the crease and gets a thick outside edge that flies past short third man for a boundary.
Grace Harris walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Floated nicely, full and on middle by Devika Vaidya, Ellyse Perry shimmies down the track and to go over the bowler's head. Does not get the elevation on her shot and hits it flat towards long on. Harleen Deol there steadies herself and completes the catch on the second attempt.
Commentary.Howout: c Harleen Deol b Devika Vaidya

Commentary.Commentary: Short and outside off, Ashleigh Gardner rocks back and punches it to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up, full on middle, Ellyse Perry drives this one down to long on for a single.
Short and on middle by Devika Vaidya, Ashleigh Gardner pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
BEATEN! Rajeshwari Gayakwad gives this one some air, on off, turning away a bit, Ellyse Perry moves back to block it, but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Flighted, fuller on off, Ashleigh Gardner uses her feet and chips it past the bowler for a single.
Floated, short and down the leg, Ashleigh Gardner misses her flick. It is called a wide.
Shortish and on off, Ashleigh Gardner moves back and pushes it towards covers.
Floated, full and on off, Ellyse Perry uses her feet and drives it towards long off for a run.
Short and outside off, Ellyse Perry chops it towards covers.
FOUR! Short and drifting onto the pads, Ellyse Perry waits for it and helps this one behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Full and outside off, Ashleigh Gardner drills it towards wide of deep point for a brace.

OUT! STUMPED! Shafali Verma strikes in her first over! Tossed up on a length outside off, Tahlia McGrath shimmies down the track to get to the pitch of the delivery. The ball keeps straight and sneaks past the inside edge and Richa Ghosh does the rest. End of a blazing knock by Tahlia McGrath and a timely wicket for India Women. Also, Ashleigh Gardner comes out to the middle now.
Commentary.Howout: st Richa Ghosh b Shafali Verma

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Powered away! This is tossed up, full and outside off, Tahlia McGrath reaches for it and smashes it past covers for a boundary.
Flatter, full and around leg, Tahlia McGrath moves across to play the sweep, but misses.
Shortish and outside off, Ellyse Perry cuts it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Shafali Verma starts with short delivery, on offf, Tahlia McGrath slaps it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller outside off, Tahlia McGrath gets down and drives it to long off for a single.
Short on off, Tahlia McGrath cuts it to cover for a dot.

Overthrows! Short around off, Ellyse Perry cuts it hard towards point and sets off for a quick single. Deepti Sharma there fires in a throw at the non-striker's end but misses. The backing isn't good enough and the ball races between deep mid-wicket and deep square leg for a boundary. Ellyse Perry was gone had Deepti Sharma hit.
Short on off, Ellyse Perry goes back and cuts it straight to backward point for a dot.
Short and outside off, Tahlia McGrath rocks back and cuts it to deep cover for a single.
DROPPED! Slower and on a length around off, Tahlia McGrath stays in the crease and goes for the cut. Gets an outside edge but Richa Ghosh fails to hang onto it.
Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes into the attack now.
Full on off, Tahlia McGrath gets forward and drives it to mid off for a single. An expensive over by Deepti Sharma comes to an end.
SIX! Cracking shot by Tahlia McGrath! Slower and on a length outside off, Tahlia McGrath advances down the track and swats this one towards the long on fence for the second maximum of the over.
WIDE! Deepti Sharma fires this one short and too wide outside off. Tahlia McGrath leaves it alone.
Fullish outside off, Tahlia McGrath fails to get underneath the delivery and jams it out.
SIX! Tossed up, full and outside off, Tahlia McGrath is onto the ball in a flash and goes through with the swing. Clears the long off fence for a maximum.
FOUR! SHOT! Flighted, full and around off, Tahlia McGrath shimmies down the track and gets to the pitch of the delivery. Creams the drive through covers and collects a boundary.
Fullish delivery outside off, Tahlia McGrath uses her feet to drive but mishits it back to the bowler.

Anjali Sarvani continues with her fuller length, on middle, shaping in, Ellyse Perry misses her drive and gets hit on the pads. There is another appeal for LBW, but the finger stays down. Only two run from the over.
Fuller in length and on middle, Ellyse Perry drives it towards mid on.
Back of a length and on middle, Tahlia McGrath works it through square leg for a run.
Full again and on middle, Tahlia McGrath blocks it back to the bowler.
Goes fuller and on leg, shaping in, Tahlia McGrath uses here feet to flick it away, but misses and gets hit high on her pads. There is a stiffled appeal for LBW but turned down.
Back of a length and on middle, Ellyse Perry tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated, short and on off, turning in, Tahlia McGrath looks to cut but mistimes it onto the ground.
Flatter, full and on middle, Ellyse Perry drills it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Ellyse Perry gets off the mark in style! This is short and outside off, Ellyse Perry moves back and cuts it past point for a boundary.
Ellyse Perry is the new batter in.

OUT! STUMPED! Deepti Sharma strikes! Australia Women lose both their openers. Deepti Sharma flights this up nicely around middle, turning away, draws the batter forward. Phoebe Litchfield obliges and uses her feet to push it away, but once again get beaten by the turn away. Richa Ghosh behind the stumps collects the does the rest. Australia Women two down now.
Commentary.Howout: st Richa Ghosh b Deepti Sharma

Commentary.Commentary: TURN AND BOUNCE! This is tossed up, full and around off, turning away, Phoebe Litchfield looks to block it but gets beaten by the turn and misses it.
Deepti Sharma starts with a short delivery, outsude off, Phoebe Litchfield punches it towards covers.
Deepti Sharma is introduced into the attack.
A maiden over then! Renuka Singh goes fuller this time, on middle, Tahlia McGrath blocks it down the pitch.
Five dots in a row now! This is on a good length and on middle, shaping in, Tahlia McGrath looks to work it away, but misses and gets hit on her pads.
This is on a good length and around off, Tahlia McGrath punches it but finds Radha Yadav at point.
Pitched up, on middle, Tahlia McGrath flicks it nicely but straight to mid-wicket.
Renuka Singh serves this full again, on off, swinging in sharply, Tahlia McGrath goes for the drive but gets an inside edge onto her pads as the ball goes nowhere.
Full and on off, Tahlia McGrath pushes it towards point.
This is on a hard length and on outside off, Phoebe Litchfield move across to play the scoop but misses and gets hit on her thigh pads.
Back of a length and outside off, Phoebe Litchfield slashes but cannot connect.
A slower one, on a length but way outside off, Phoebe Litchfield tries to cut it, but misses. It is called a wide again.
Full and down the leg, Phoebe Litchfield misses her flick. Wided.

Overthrows! This is full again and outside off, Phoebe Litchfield drills it wide of sweeper cover and comes back for the second. The fielder there throws it at the keeper's end, but the ball hit Phoebe Litchfield's bat and runs away to the thrid man fence for a boundary. Australia Women gets six runs of this delivery.
Fuller one and around leg, Tahlia McGrath flicks it through square leg for a single and gets off the mark.
A low full toss, on middle, shaping in, Tahlia McGrath knocks it towards mid on.
Tahlia McGrath walks in at number 3 for Australia Women.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Anjali Sarvani draws first blood! She gets the dangerous Beth Mooney on her very first delivery. She bowls this full and outside off, Beth Mooney skips down the track to drive it away, but only manages to get an inside edge back onto the stumps. India Women get an early wicket and Anjali Sarvani is absolutely pumped here.
It will be Anjali Sarvani to bowl from the other end.
On a length and on off, Phoebe Litchfield goes to drive again but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

FOUR! That is the first boudnary of the innings! A lovely shot from Phoebe Litchfield! This is full and on middle, Phoebe Litchfield stays there and drives it with the full face of the bat past the bowler for four runs.
Back of a length and on off, shaping in, Beth Mooney gets cramped and pushes it towards point for a run.
Goes fuller this time, on middle, Phoebe Litchfield drives it towards mid on for a single and gets off the mark.
Back of a length and on off, Beth Mooney gudies it uppishly but safely towards point for a single.
BEAUTY! Renuka Singh comes around the wicket and bowls this on a hard length and on off, shaping away a bit, Beth Mooney looks to play at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Renuka Singh starts with a wayward delivery! She bowl this on a good length but just down the leg side, Beth Mooney misses her flick. It is called a wide and Australia Women are underway.

We are all set for the action to start. The umpires and players make their way out in the middle. Beth Mooney and Phoebe Litchfield will be the openers for Australia Women. Renuka Singh will start the proceedings with the ball for India Women.

Tahlia McGrath, the stand-in skipper of Australia Women, says that they would have bowled first as well. Says that leading her side to the WBBL title gave her a lot of confidence. Adds that captaining Australia has been a seamless transition with seniors there to help. Shares that they want to win every game they play. Ends by informing that they have made two changes to their side - Phoebe Litchfield comes in for the injured Alyssa Healy and Kim Garth comes in for Megan Schutt.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the skipper of India Women, says that they are going to bowl first considering the dew in the second innings. Adds that played really well in the last game and they want to continue to do the same. Shares that they are going with an extra spinner in this game. Feels that they wanted to improve in every game of the series and they have achieved the target. Ends by informing that they have made one change to their team - Rajeshwari Gayakwad comes in for Jemimah Rodrigues.

Australia Women (Playing XI) - Beth Mooney (WK), Phoebe Litchfield (In for Alyssa Healy), Tahlia McGrath (C), Ashleigh Gardner, Ellyse Perry, Grace Harris, Annabel Sutherland, Heather Graham, Alana King, Kim Garth (In for Megan Schutt), Darcie Brown.

India Women (Playing XI) - Shafali Verma, Smriti Mandhana, Harleen Deol, Harmanpreet Kaur (C), Devika Vaidya, Richa Ghosh (WK), Deepti Sharma, Radha Yadav, Anjali Sarvani, Rajeshwari Gayakwad (In for Jemimah Rodrigues), Renuka Singh.
TOSS – The coin toss lands in the favour of India Women and they have opted to bowl first.

India Women, on the other hand, have put up a decent challenge to the Aussies, but just couldn't get over the line in the last two T20Is. This series has been very competitive and both teams will take a lot of positives from it. However, they can also try out some different players and test their bench strength. Will India Women finish with a bang? Or will Australia Women take the series 4-1? We will find out soon. Toss and team news in a bit.

Australia Women have shown why they are considered as the best in the world. They have been brilliant with the bat and the key to their success is to win the middle overs which they did. Their top-order has been good and the form of Ellyse Perry and Grace Harris has been a big plus point for them. However, their bowling needs to improve a bit as they have let Indian batters take the game deep on a couple of occasions. Since the result of this game will not have an impact on the series, they can try to change their squad a bit and provide opportunities to other players.

Hello and a warm welcome folks! It is almost time for the fifth and final game of the five-match T20I series between India Women and Australia Women at the Brabourne Stadium in Mumbai. The Aussies have already sealed the series and will look to finish on a high while the home team will want to give their fans something to cheer for. All the games have been pretty exciting so far and even though the result will not matter much here, we can expect another thrilling encounter.
... MATCH DAY ...

It is time for the fifth and final T20I game of the Australia tour of India. The visitors are leading the series by 3-1 and India Women will look to end the series on a high. India Women's team hasn't had a good record against the Aussies in recent times. Harmanpreet Kaur's side has played well, but they haven't managed to match up to the standards of the Aussies. Their openers, Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana have done well at the top. The side would need a good start from them in this game. In the middle order, Jemimah Rodrigues must do well with Kaur and Devika Vaidya. Deepti Sharma, Richa Ghosh, and Harleen Deol add depth to this batting line-up, and the side will look for some better cameos from them. Their bowlers have been under pressure as the Aussies have outplayed them. The Indian skipper would like a better show from her bowlers in this contest and win it to salvage lost pride. Alyssa Healy would be happy with her side's campaign on this tour. They came in as the favorites and have lived up to this reputation. Beth Mooney has scored runs, and the side would like to see her offer a good start along with Alyssa Healy. The middle order has the firepower, and the team would expect runs from Ellyse Perry, Tahlia McGrath, and Ashleigh Gardner. Their bowlers haven't found it easy on these surfaces and the side would like early wickets from their bowlers. Can India Women turn the tide and win this game? Or will Australia Women continue to dominate? We shall find out together.
